royaltiesBRL.label: Royalties generated by local artists on Spotify

notes: Two kinds of country data. (1) The FY2025 20-F itemises 2025 average employees only for the U.S. (3,466), Sweden (1,271) and the U.K. (887); it gives approximately 1,663 'employees and contractors' in aggregate across about 25 other countries, which is not a country row. (2) Loud & Clear 2026 (2025 data), from Spotify's own newsroom posts for that edition: Sweden (nearly SEK 2 billion, 'nära 2 miljarder kronor'), Brazil (approximately BRL 2 billion) and Canada (over CAD 544 million). No newer EU figure was found (checked Nov 24, 2026: the newsroom's Europe, European Union and Loud & Clear tags have no 2026 EU post), so the EU row keeps the Loud & Clear 2025 figure (€1.7 billion for 2024) and its metric keeps period 2024. Royalties are by artist origin, paid to rights holders, not to artists directly. Each currency is its own metric; they are not comparable or additive. Sweden has two rows because the employee and royalty figures come from different documents. India's 2026 post gives growth rates and thresholds but no total, so it is not recorded. Office lease space comes from Item 4.D (occupied space is lower: about 226,000 and 378,000 sq ft). The FY2025 20-F no longer lists a Minneapolis regional office, so that site was removed. No U.S. state data.
